findings.claim: The full-mode sequence no longer explicitly checks manifest readiness before invoking project-architect. It stops only on a blocker, while the remaining final-enough gate applies before the roadmap. A draft or partial manifest without an explicit blocker can therefore advance to architecture prematurely. Restore the manifest readiness gate between these producer invocations.
proof_refs: The removed Critical Patterns section explicitly required: 'Do NOT produce the architecture until the manifest is final enough.'
The replacement Execution Steps item 2 invokes project-manifest and then project-architect, requiring only 'stop on a blocker'.
The replacement Decision Gates paragraph requires final-enough manifest and architecture 'before the roadmap', leaving the earlier transition unspecified.
